description: Write the evidence matrix and GO decision table as CSV provenance artifacts and plot the summary comparison of column scores
code:
import pandas as pd, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
print("cwd:",os.getcwd()); print("existing:",sorted(os.listdir(".")))

ev = pd.DataFrame([

ev.to_csv("set6_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)

go = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(go_id="GO:0016279",name="protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity",aspect="MF",
      current="IBA GO_REF:0000033",action="RETAIN",
      reason="supported by 8/8 catalytic columns, separation from 4 pseudo-enzymes, 100% conservation of N303-H304-C306 across 15 orthologs"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0042054",name="histone methyltransferase activity",aspect="MF",
      current="IBA GO_REF:0000033",action="GENERALIZE to GO:0016279 (over-annotated)",
      reason="no Set6 substrate ever assayed; IBA propagation from Set5 (34.6% id over 81 aa, SET-C only); no Pfam-detectable MYND"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0006338",name="chromatin remodeling",aspect="BP",
      current="IEA GO_REF:0000108",action="REMOVE or treat as non-core",
      reason="auto-propagated from the MF term being generalized; no Set6 chromatin phenotype on record"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0008270",name="zinc ion binding",aspect="MF",
      current="RCA PMID:30358795",action="RETAIN, add structural support",
      reason="post-SET Cys3 + C306 + H304 single donor cluster, 3.62 A max donor-centroid, pLDDT 93.4"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005634",name="nucleus",aspect="CC",
      current="IBA GO_REF:0000033",action="UNRESOLVED, leave pending localization data",
      reason="no Set6 localization experiment found; Set5 nuclear CC is Set5-specific"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0008757",name="S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methyltransferase activity",aspect="MF",
      current="absent",action="CANDIDATE ADDITION, low priority",
      reason="same residue evidence as GO:0016279 but less informative"),
])
go.to_csv("set6_go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote:",[f for f in sorted(os.listdir(".")) if f.endswith(".csv")])
print("\n=== GO decision table ===")
print(go[["go_id","aspect","current","action"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nevidence matrix rows:",len(ev),"| stance counts:")
print(ev["stance"].value_counts().to_string())

# summary figure of the three independent lines of evidence, all computed in this run
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
labels=["Set6\n(test)","Set5\n(active, IDA)","SMYD1/2/3/5\n(active, mean)","non-SMYD active\n(anchoring-limited)","Set3/Set4/MLL5/SETD5\n(inactive)"]
vals=[8.0,8.0,8.0,4.17,1.5]
cols=["#1a9850","#66bd63","#66bd63","#bdbdbd","#d73027"]
b=ax.bar(labels,vals,color=cols)
for r,v in zip(b,vals): ax.text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2,v+0.12,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(8,ls="--",lw=0.8,color="k")
ax.set_ylabel("catalytic / cofactor columns matched (of 8)"); ax.set_ylim(0,9)
ax.set_title("Set6 matches every structure-derived catalytic column.\nGrey bar is alignment-coverage limited, not evidence of residue loss.",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
